title: Set 273

sentences.ko: 우리 고양이가 요즘 욕실 세면대에서 자기 시작했거든. 옮기고 싶은데 그러면 엄청 화를 내서, 그냥 부엌에서 양치하고 있어.
sentences.text: Our cat's started sleeping in the bathroom sink, and I'd move her, but she gets so mad about it that I've just been brushing my teeth in the kitchen.

alts.text: So the cat's decided the bathroom sink is her bed now. I'd kick her out, but she gets super mad, so I've just been brushing my teeth in the kitchen.
Our cat has started sleeping in the bathroom sink. I would move her, but she becomes so upset about it that I have simply been brushing my teeth in the kitchen.

sentences.note: **I'd move her, but** 는 옮기고는 싶지만 실제로는 안 한다는 뜻이에요. **I've just been brushing my teeth** 처럼 have been ~ing 를 쓰면 요즘 계속 그러고 있다는 느낌이 나요.

sentences.ko: 내 폰이 배터리가 40%나 남았는데 자꾸 꺼져. 배터리 문제인 줄 알고 교체까지 했는데 아직도 그래. 그래서 이제 폰이 문제인지 내가 뭘 잘못 쓰고 있는 건지 모르겠어.
sentences.text: My phone keeps dying at like forty percent. I thought it was the battery, so I had it replaced, but it's still doing it, so now I don't know if it's the phone or something I'm doing.

alts.text: Ugh, my phone just dies at like forty percent. Figured it was the battery, got it swapped, and it's still doing it. So is it the phone or is it me? No clue.

My phone continues to shut off at approximately forty percent. I assumed the battery was at fault and had it replaced, but the problem persists, so I am now unsure whether the issue lies with the phone or with something I am doing.

sentences.note: **keeps dying** 는 폰이 자꾸 저절로 꺼진다는 말이에요. **had it replaced** 는 내가 직접 바꾼 게 아니라 맡겨서 교체했다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 누가 물어보면 나 내일 아침 일찍 비행기 탄다고 해 줘, 알았지? 사실은 아닌데, 노래방까지 남아 있으면 새벽 두 시까지 꼼짝없이 여기 있어야 하거든.
sentences.text: If anybody asks, I've got an early flight tomorrow, okay? I don't, but if I stay for karaoke, I'm going to be stuck here till two in the morning.

alts.text: Anyone asks, I've got an early flight tomorrow, okay? I don't, but if I stick around for karaoke, I'm stuck here till 2 a.m.
Should anyone inquire, I have an early flight tomorrow. That is not true, but if I stay for karaoke, I will not be able to leave until two in the morning.

sentences.note: **If anybody asks** 는 핑계를 미리 맞춰 둘 때 자주 쓰는 말이에요. **be stuck here** 는 빠져나가지 못하고 꼼짝없이 붙잡혀 있다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 금요일 말고 목요일 밤에 출발하면 거기서 하루를 통째로 더 있을 수 있어. 근데 그러려면 상사한테 물어봐야 하는데, 지난달에 이미 하루 쉬었거든. 뭐 예약하기 전에 내가 상사한테 먼저 얘기해 볼게.
sentences.text: If we fly out Thursday night instead of Friday, we'd get a whole extra day there, but I'd have to ask my boss, and I already took a day off last month. Let me talk to him before we book anything.

alts.text: Leaving Thursday night instead of Friday gets us a whole extra day there. But I'd need to ask my boss, and I already took a day off last month. Lemme check with him before we book anything.

If we were to depart on Thursday evening rather than Friday, we would gain an additional full day there. However, I would need to ask my manager, and I already took a day off last month. I would like to speak with him before we make any reservations.

sentences.note: **fly out** 은 비행기를 타고 떠난다는 뜻이에요. **took a day off** 는 하루 휴가를 냈다는 말이고, **Let me talk to him** 은 내가 먼저 얘기해 보겠다고 할 때 써요.

sentences.ko: 삼촌은 볼 때마다 이제 제대로 된 직장 구했냐고 물어. 내가 지금 하는 일은 일도 아니라는 듯이. 이번에는 그냥 알아보는 중이라고만 했어. 설명하려고 하면 질문만 더 늘어날 게 뻔했거든.
sentences.text: Every time I see my uncle, he asks if I've found a real job yet, like what I do now doesn't count. This time I just said I'm working on it, because I knew if I tried to explain, he'd have even more questions.

alts.text: My uncle always asks if I've got a real job yet. Like what I do now doesn't count? So this time I just said I'm working on it, 'cause explaining would just mean more questions.

Each time I see my uncle, he asks whether I have found a real job yet, as though my current work does not count. On this occasion I simply told him that I was working on it, because I knew that if I attempted to explain, he would have even more questions.

sentences.note: **a real job** 은 남들이 인정해 주는 번듯한 직장이라는 뜻이에요. **I'm working on it** 은 지금 하고 있다고 대충 넘길 때 쓰는 말이고, **like what I do now doesn't count** 의 like 는 마치 ~인 것처럼이라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

reviewed: 2번 note: keeps dying 을 배터리가 나가서 꺼진다고 설명했는데, 이 문장은 40%나 남았는데 꺼지는 얘기라 뜻이 어긋나서 고침
2번 한국어: 40% 정도만 돼도 는 뜻이 흐려서 40%나 남았는데 로 고침
3번 formal: stuck 의 꼼짝없이 붙잡힌다는 뜻이 빠져서 will not be able to leave 로 되살림
4번 한국어: 뭐 예약하기 전에 내가 먼저 얘기해 볼게 는 누구에게 얘기하는지 흐려서 상사를 넣어 고침
5번 casual: 따옴표 없이 삼촌 말을 옮겨 소리내어 읽으면 어디까지가 인용인지 헷갈려서 새로 씀
5번 formal: told him that I am working on it 은 시제가 안 맞아 I was working on it 으로 고침
